metadata.question: In parts of East Midlands, northeast England, and eastern Scotland, was there more rain during October 1, 2023, and January 4, 2024 as compared to their 1991-2020 average rainfalls for those months?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - I need to compare rainfall data for October 2023 and January 2024 against the 1991-2020 average for those months in three regions: East Midlands, northeast England, and eastern Scotland. - I'll use CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) which provides daily precipitation estimates. - For each region, I'll calculate: (1) Total rainfall Oct 2023 & Jan 2024, (2) Average rainfall for Oct and Jan across 1991-2020. 2. Masking strategy: - CHIRPS doesn't require cloud masking as it's a precipitation product that already provides quality-controlled daily estimates. - I need to ensure the geometry is valid and within bounds. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs. Null/Error: - Valid Zero: A region with 0 rainfall is plausible (C2 would apply only if pixel count is literally 0, not if rainfall is 0). - Null/Error: If CHIRPS collection is empty, or if calculations return NaN/None, output C3. - No Data: If no images exist for the period, output C1. - I'll compare: if (Oct2023 + Jan2024) > (Oct_avg_1991_2020 + Jan_avg_1991_2020), then "Yes" (A), else "No" (B). ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define three regions const eastMidlands = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-2.5, 52.8], [-0.5, 52.8], [-0.5, 51.8], [-2.5, 51.8], [-2.5, 52.8]] ]); const northeastEngland = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-2.5, 55.0], [-0.5, 55.0], [-0.5, 54.2], [-2.5, 54.2], [-2.5, 55.0]] ]); const easternScotland = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-2.5, 57.0], [-0.5, 57.0], [-0.5, 55.8], [-2.5, 55.8], [-2.5, 57.0]] ]); const regions = [ { name: 'East Midlands', geom: eastMidlands }, { name: 'Northeast England', geom: northeastEngland }, { name: 'Eastern Scotland', geom: easternScotland } ]; // Load CHIRPS precipitation data const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY'); let allResults = []; for (const region of regions) { print(`\n=== ${region.name} ===`); // October 2023 and January 2024 const oct2023 = chirps .filterDate('2023-10-01', '2023-10-31') .filterBounds(region.geom); const jan2024 = chirps .filterDate('2024-01-01', '2024-01-04') .filterBounds(region.geom); const oct2023Size = oct2023.size().getInfo(); const jan2024Size = jan2024.size().getInfo(); if (oct2023Size === 0 || jan2024Size === 0) { print(`Data missing: Oct2023=${oct2023Size}, Jan2024=${jan2024Size}`); print('Result: C1'); allResults.push('C1'); continue; } // Calculate total rainfall for Oct 2023 and Jan 2024 const oct2023Total = oct2023.sum().reduceRegion( ee.Reducer.mean(), region.geom, 1000, 1e9 ).get('precipitation').getInfo(); const jan2024Total = jan2024.sum().reduceRegion( ee.Reducer.mean(), region.geom, 1000, 1e9 ).get('precipitation').getInfo(); if (oct2023Total === null || jan2024Total === null) { print('Calculation failed (null values)'); print('Result: C3'); allResults.push('C3'); continue; } // Calculate 1991-2020 average for October and January const octAvg1991_2020 = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(10, 10, 'month')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(1991, 2020, 'year')) .filterBounds(region.geom) .sum() .reduceRegion( ee.Reducer.mean(), region.geom, 1000, 1e9 ).get('precipitation').getInfo(); const janAvg1991_2020 = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(1, 1, 'month')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(1991, 2020, 'year')) .filterBounds(region.geom) .sum() .reduceRegion( ee.Reducer.mean(), region.geom, 1000, 1e9 ).get('precipitation').getInfo(); if (octAvg1991_2020 === null || janAvg1991_2020 === null) { print('Historical average calculation failed'); print('Result: C3'); allResults.push('C3'); continue; } const recent = oct2023Total + jan2024Total; const historical = octAvg1991_2020 + janAvg1991_2020; print(`Oct 2023: ${oct2023Total.toFixed(1)} mm`); print(`Jan 2024: ${jan2024Total.toFixed(1)} mm`); print(`Oct Avg (1991-2020): ${octAvg1991_2020.toFixed(1)} mm`); print(`Jan Avg (1991-2020): ${janAvg1991_2020.toFixed(1)} mm`); print(`Recent Total: ${recent.toFixed(1)} mm`); print(`Historical Avg: ${historical.toFixed(1)} mm`); if (recent > historical) { print('Result: YES (more rain in 2023-2024)'); allResults.push('A'); } else { print('Result: NO (less or equal rain in 2023-2024)'); allResults.push('B'); } } // Summary: If all regions show more rain, answer A; if mixed/all show less, answer B print(`\n=== SUMMARY ===`); print(`Results: ${allResults.join(', ')}`); const yesCount = allResults.filter(r => r === 'A').length; const noCount = allResults.filter(r => r === 'B').length; if (allResults.includes('C1') || allResults.includes('C3')) { print(allResults.includes('C1') ? 'C1' : 'C3'); } else if (yesCount > noCount) { print('A'); } else { print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
